correctness.rationale: Proof establishes spectral equivalence by propagation of max-modulus equality on all supported two-step paths, then Lyapunov-supermartingale almost-sure stability. The gauge converts balanced models to ordinary irreducible P-drift, giving bounded stationary-weight martingale convergence and stable transverse modes. Independent Bernoulli innovations imply an exact positive first-step variance bound. Replayed exact rational checks verify 1367 small irreducible network cases and the primitive four-state example; the infinite claim depends on mathematical proof.
